title: 第16章这是保安吧-《穿越60带着空间当保安》
content:
第(1/3)页

    钱主任带着王野来到保卫科，保卫科在厂子大门处的一排平房。平房的开头是门房，平房的结尾是科长办公室。这一排房子都是保卫科的得有十好几间。有科员办公室，有库房，还有审讯室。

    没错就是审讯室，现在的保卫科权力可是很大的。厂里的大事小情都能过问，小到打架斗殴小偷小摸，大到缉拿特务打击犯罪全都可以管。

    到了保卫科长办公室钱科长开门就进一声大喝：“老吴，干嘛呢，一天天就你闲！”

    王野跟着进入办公室就看见一个人报纸盖在脸上，脚翘在办公桌上，正在呼呼大睡。

    因为钱主任的一声大喝睡觉的男人差点掉在地上。坐稳身子张嘴就骂：“你个钱四眼儿，没事儿来我这儿干嘛。”

    “这不是有人安排进你们保卫科，我给你送过来”

    吴姓男人想了一下想起师傅说的给自己找的徒弟顿时来了兴趣：“哦哦哦，想起来了，你就是我师傅说的小野吧”。吴姓男人看着王野说道。

    王野看见这个男人立刻就想起了前世教自己八极拳的老头，王野心里仿佛一万只草泥马跑过，王野心想：“这踏马也太巧了吧，前世的老头在这儿呢？这也不对呀，现在老头就当科长了，这要是再过个三十年，就算混三十年日子也不会想后世那样落魄呀。”

    “这踏马到底是我这只小蝴蝶扇的，还是以后会有变故。这踏马前世也没问呀。要是有什么变故，要是知道也可以提前避免一下。擦，可以重新穿一次吗。”

    “喂喂喂，小子，想啥呢。”在吴科长的叫声中王野回过神来。吴科长：“小子，是不是被我的气质吓到了”。王野回过神后也不纠结了笑着说“吴叔，我先问问，说实话挨打不？”

    吴科长：“你个臭小子果然和我师傅说的一样。”王野好奇的问：“吴叔，赵爷爷咋说我的？”吴科长没好气的说：“去去去，你自己问去，我要是背后讲道师傅肯定少不了一顿打。”

    钱科长疑惑的问：“等会儿，等会儿，你们认识？”吴科长解释道：“这小子和我师父一个院的，行了老钱你去忙吧，我带这小子去我师傅那儿打个招呼。”

    钱科长：“老吴，你踏马就这么卸磨杀....呸，用人朝前不用人朝后呀。”吴科长：“咋滴送个人过来我还得请你喝一顿呗？”

    钱科长：“我踏马好歹是个科长，要不是咱的关系，送个人用我这个科长亲自来呀？”。

    王野赶紧说：“钱科长，没事儿我去您办公室玩，您可不能轰我呦”。

    钱科长：“看看人家小王多会说话呀，你呀都多余长一张嘴，哼。小王呀没事儿来钱叔办公室，我哪儿有茶，有烟，管够。”王野也就坡下驴的叫着：“谢谢钱叔了，以后钱叔叫我小野就行”。钱科长嗯了一声就走了。理都没理吴科长。

    吴科长一脸疑惑的问王野：“小子，你和老钱原来认识？”王野：“不认识呀”吴科长疑惑的说：“不认识你们聊得这么好”

    王野说：“这不是今天认识了吗”。吴科长问道：“今天刚认识就可以这么熟了？”王野说反问道：“今天刚认识不能这么熟吗？”

    没两句吴科长就被问懵了。挠着头说：“你是不是绕我呢？”王野强忍着笑说：“吴叔，你说什么呢我怎么绕你了，对了我和赵爷爷一起来的工厂，现在赵爷爷应该在等咱们吧？”王野赶紧转移话题。

    吴科长赶紧说：“对对对，走走赶紧去找我师父”。说着就拉着王野往门房处快步走去。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Director Qian took Wang Ye to the Security Department, which was located in a row of bungalows at the factory gate.The beginning of the bungalow is the concierge, and the end of the bungalow is the section chief's office.There must be more than a dozen houses in this row belonging to the security department.There are clerk's offices, warehouses, and interrogation rooms.

That’s right, it’s the interrogation room. The current security department has great power.He can handle all the big and small matters in the factory, from fights to petty thefts, to arresting spies and fighting crimes.

When we arrived at the Security Section Chief's office, Section Chief Qian opened the door and shouted, "Old Wu, what are you doing? You have nothing to do all day long!"

Wang Ye followed him into the office and saw a man with a newspaper covering his face and his feet on the desk, sleeping soundly.

The man who was sleeping almost fell to the ground because of Director Qian’s loud shout.He sat upright and opened his mouth to curse: "You rich guy with four eyes, why did you come to my place when you have nothing to do?"

"This is not someone who has been arranged to enter your security department. I will send it to you."

The man surnamed Wu thought for a moment and suddenly became interested when he remembered the apprentice his master had mentioned for him: "Oh, oh, I remember, you are the Xiaoye my master mentioned."The man surnamed Wu looked at Wang Ye and said.

When Wang Ye saw this man, he immediately thought of the old man who taught him Bajiquan in his previous life. In Wang Ye's mind, it was as if ten thousand grass and mud horses were running past. Wang Ye thought: "It's a coincidence that the old man from the previous life is here. This is not right. Now the old man will be the section chief. If another thirty years pass, even if he lives for thirty years, he will not be as depressed as he will be in the future."

"Whether this horse is fanned by my little butterfly, or there will be changes in the future. I didn't ask about the past life of this horse. If there is any change, if you know, you can avoid it in advance. Wipe it, can you wear it again?"

"Hey, hey, hey, kid, what are you thinking about?" Wang Ye came back to his senses when Section Chief Wu called out.Section Chief Wu: "Boy, are you scared by my temperament?"After Wang Ye came back to his senses, he no longer hesitated and said with a smile, "Uncle Wu, let me ask first, will you be beaten if you tell the truth?"

Section Chief Wu: "You brat is exactly what my master said." Wang Ye asked curiously: "Uncle Wu, what did Grandpa Zhao say about me?" Section Chief Wu said angrily: "Go, go, ask yourself. If I preach behind my back, the master will definitely get a beating."

Section Chief Qian asked doubtfully: "Wait a minute, wait a minute, do you know each other?" Section Chief Wu explained: "This kid is from the same hospital as my master. Okay, old Qian, you can go and do your work. I will take this kid to my master's place to say hello."

Section Chief Qian: "Old Wu, you're just going to kill me when you're riding a horse... Bah, you have to use people to go forward and not people to go behind." Section Chief Wu: "Why do you send someone here and I have to treat you to a drink?"

Section Chief Qian: "I am a section chief after all. If it weren't for our relationship, why don't I send someone to come in person as the section chief?"

Wang Ye quickly said: "Chief Qian, if nothing happens, I will go to your office to play, but you can't attack me."

Section Chief Qian: "Look at how well Xiao Wang can talk. You even have an extra mouth, huh. Xiao Wang, come to Uncle Qian's office if you have nothing to do. I have tea and cigarettes. I have enough care." Wang Ye went down the slope and brayed like a donkey: "Thank you, Uncle Qian. From now on, Uncle Qian can just call me Xiaoye."Section Chief Qian said yes and left.He ignored Section Chief Wu.

Section Chief Wu asked Wang Ye with a puzzled look on his face: "Boy, do you and Lao Qian know each other?" Wang Ye: "I don't know you." Section Chief Wu said doubtfully, "I don't know that you two can talk so well."

Wang Ye said: "Didn't we get to know each other today?"Section Chief Wu asked: "We just met today and we are so familiar with each other?" Wang Ye said and asked: "We just met today and we can't be so familiar with each other?"

Section Chief Wu was confused by the question within a few words.He scratched his head and said, "Are you trying to get around me?" Wang Ye suppressed a smile and said, "Uncle Wu, what did you say? Why did I get around you? By the way, Grandpa Zhao and I came to the factory together. Grandpa Zhao should be waiting for us now, right?" Wang Ye quickly changed the subject.

Section Chief Wu quickly said: "Yes, yes, come and find my master."After saying that, he pulled Wang Ye and walked quickly towards the concierge.

title_en: Chapter 16 Is this a security guard - "Traveling through 60 and taking space as a security guard"
